ablation.name: phase4h1b_eota_per_subband_a05
ablation.notes: Phase 4H.1b: EOTA + per_subband + alpha=0.5. CRITICAL CONTROL experiment. 4H.1a (EOTA + alpha=1.0) ≈ 4G.2 (every-step + alpha=1.0) because (1-1.0)^n=0 for any n. The REAL test of EOTA is with alpha<1.0: if 4H.1b (EOTA + alpha=0.5) differs from 4G.2b (every-step + alpha=0.5, lpips=0.3845), then EOTA restores alpha effectiveness. If identical, the problem is per_subband's 9-subband independent matching itself (not alpha). Theory: EOTA single-step residual (1-0.5)^1=0.5 (50% residual) vs every-step (1-0.5)^12=0.024% (0.024% residual). This is the decisive experiment.
